about: Saint-Lazare is a city on Montréal’s West Island fringe in Montérégie, west of Vaudreuil-Dorion toward the Ontario border approaches. It is known for equestrian estates, low-density residential streets, and remaining woodland—more countryside suburb than dense city. Highway 40 access ties residents into Greater Montréal. About 22,000 people live in Saint-Lazare.
